todayFinds.title_zh: 大清雍正年制款窑变釉贯耳瓶
todayFinds.desc_zh: 窑变釉贯耳瓶，釉色变化丰富，紫蓝交融，器型端庄，贯耳经典制式。釉面莹润，为清代雍正风格窑变釉陈设瓷。
todayFinds.desc_en: Flambe‑glaze vase with pierced ears. Rich blended purple and blue glaze colour, dignified shape with classic pierced‑ear design. Glossy glaze surface, Yongzheng‑style flambe‑glaze display porcelain of Qing dynasty.

todayFinds.title_zh: 战国青铜错金乳钉双耳四足方鼎
todayFinds.desc_zh: 战国青铜方鼎，错金乳钉纹。器身方正，四足双耳，错金纹饰古朴华丽，铸造工艺精湛，包浆厚重自然，是高古青铜重器。
todayFinds.desc_en: Warring‑States bronze square ding with gold‑inlaid stud patterns. Square body, four feet and double ears. Elegant ancient gold‑inlaid ornamentation with sophisticated casting craft and natural thick patina, an important ancient bronze artifact.

todayFinds.title_zh: 战国错金银青铜瑞兽摆件
todayFinds.desc_zh: 错金银青铜瑞兽，造型生动，体态矫健。通体错金银纹饰，细节刻画入微，包浆温润，战国时期青铜陈设摆件。
todayFinds.desc_en: Bronze beast inlaid gold and silver with vivid and powerful shape. Fully decorated with gold and silver inlay, exquisitely carved details and mellow patina, Warring States bronze ornament.

todayFinds.title_zh: 大明宣德青花描金云龙纹扁瓶
todayFinds.title_en: Ming Xuande Blue-and-Gold Dragon Flat Vase
todayFinds.desc_zh: 此件扁瓶，青花加描金工艺，纹饰绘云龙，线条遒劲。器型规整，胎质细腻，青花发色沉稳，描金华丽，保存状态良好，为明代精品陈设瓷器。
todayFinds.desc_en: This flat vase adopts blue‑and‑white with gold tracing craft, decorated with dragon patterns in powerful lines. Regular shape with fine porcelain body, stable blue‑and‑white colour and gorgeous gold tracing. Well preserved, a fine Ming display porcelain.
